name: AudioStream
short: Schedule local media for playback in a voice channel.
description: Bot owners choose a local media folder. Server administrators can then use an interactive picker to select a file, voice or stage channel, and start time. The bot disconnects automatically when playback finishes.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store any Discord user data.
install_msg: AudioStream loaded. Make sure FFmpeg is installed on the bot host, set a folder with `[p]audiostreamset folder <path>`, and run `[p]audiostream`.
